== BITwiki Organizational Components ==

BITwiki's organizational structure is built around five key components:

=== 1. Portals ===

{{:Component:Portals_section}}

=== 2. Semantic Organization ===

{{:Component:Semantic_section}}

=== 3. Transclusion Structure ===

{{:Component:Transclusion_section}}

=== 4. Knowledge Graph ===

{{:Component:Knowledge_graph_section}}

=== 5. Implementation Strategies ===

{{:Component:Implementation_section}}

== Component Integration ==

These five components work together to create a coherent, maintainable wiki:

'' '''Portals''' provide thematic entry points
'' '''Semantic Organization''' creates explicit relationships
'' '''Transclusion''' enables modular content
'' '''Knowledge Graph''' connects ideas to implementations
* '''Implementation''' provides practical execution
